final: WITH invoice_stats AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(derived_product_cost AS FLOAT)) as avg_product_cost, AVG(CAST(derived_total_cost AS FLOAT) / CAST(product_price AS FLOAT)) as avg_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items WHERE derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND product_price IS NOT NULL AND product_price != 0 GROUP BY invoice_number), overall_ratio AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(derived_total_cost AS FLOAT) / CAST(product_price AS FLOAT)) as overall_avg_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items WHERE derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND product_price IS NOT NULL AND product_price != 0) SELECT AVG(s.avg_product_cost) as avg_product_cost, AVG(s.avg_ratio) as avg_ratio, AVG(s.avg_ratio) - (SELECT overall_avg_ratio FROM overall_ratio) as avg_distance_above_overall FROM invoice_stats s, overall_ratio o WHERE s.avg_ratio > o.overall_avg_ratio
